name: nodebox-converter
description: Converts NodeBox 3 Python and Clojure code to NodeBox 4 JavaScript: a Cloudflare Worker, plus the checker that measures conversions against NodeBox 3.

scripts.check:testset: python3 check/inventory.py "data/Node Library/node library 3-7.ndbx" "data/Node Library" > data/nl_inventory.json && python3 check/testset.py data/forum_corpus.json data/forum_ports.json "data/Node Library" data/nl_inventory.json > data/testset.json
scripts.check:js: python3 check/run.py js data/testset.json data/js.json data/out
scripts.check:report: python3 check/compare.py data/testset.json data/ref.json data/js.json data/out > data/report.json && python3 check/summary.py data/report.json
